title: Build a cushion
intro: Surprise costs happen to everyone. This Lesson shows how a cushion of savings protects you. It also shows how savings can grow by themselves.

check.prompt: An emergency fund is for planned costs, such as a holiday.
check.explanation: Myth. An emergency fund is for unplanned costs, such as car repairs.

check.prompt: Minh saves $100 at 5% interest a year and adds nothing. What does he earn in the second year?
check.explanation: More than $5. He earns interest on the $100 and on last year's $5.

check.prompt: Paying a surprise bill with a credit card can make it cost more.
check.explanation: Fact. Interest and fees can make the cost bigger than the first bill.
